title.narrative: Green industrial recovery through municipality-based development in Ukraine

description.narrative: In July 2022, UNIDO received a request from the Government of Ukraine to provide support for the reconstruction of the country#s industry and infrastructure, which are significantly affected by the ongoing war. In response, UNIDO commenced conceptualizing and discussing with the Government a green recovery programme for ISID in Ukraine to potentially cover the period from 2024 to 2028. As a result, UNIDO has mobilized funds from the Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development # BMZ (Germany) to successfully implement the project #Industrial capacity-building, policy advice and diagnostics for the green recovery of Ukraine. The overall objective of the project was to provide technical support to the Government of Ukraine in conceptualizing and operationalizing a strategic approach towards green industrial reconstruction and development through the coherent, evidence-based and result-oriented green recovery programme for ISID. One of the key deliverables of this project was the green industrial recovery programme for Ukraine and its spin-off project proposals to further support Ukraine#s resilience building and green recovery.
